summary: Reproduced the ROCm DCP decode tensor/tuple mismatch in the actual forward_absorb_rocm_core implementation. The base code omitted return_lse=True: batch size 1 raised the reported ValueError, while batch size 2 silently unpacked two output rows and advanced with an invalid LSE. The candidate requests LSE explicitly and validates the backend return contract before any collective uses it. Focused tests cover tensor-only and tuple returns for batch size one and larger, and verify that the real forward method passes the exact returned LSE to the DCP collective. Single-GPU ROCm kernel checks preserve the existing LSE numerical semantics.
